newsitem.title: USA: Checkmate Q2 may not meet break-even.
newsitem.headline: Checkmate Q2 may not meet break-even.

text.p: Checkmate Electronics Inc said Friday its quarter results "may not exceed break-even."
The company said in a statement that results cannot be forecast at this time and it plans to release quarterly results on or about July 17.
Wall Street was expecting the company to report second quarter earnings of $0.23 a share, according to First Call.
The company said unanticipated softness in retail capital spending is largely responsible for the shortfall.

Checkmate develops, makes and markets point-of-sale payment automation systems and terminals, including check readers, payment authorization systems, signature capture devices and MICR analyzers to distributors, retailers and financial service institutions.
